title: Astragaloside IV ameliorates diabetic kidney disease by modulating the PHD2/HIF-1alpha axis and inhibiting podocyte ferroptosis.
authors: Guo, YaXiong; Wang, HuiFang; Yan, PengYu; Zhang, YuLiang; Hu, YaLing; Zhao, ZhiBo; Liu, Chun; Liu, YuXiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪甲苷通过PHD2/HIF-1α轴抑制足细胞铁死亡治疗糖尿病肾病，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) lacks therapies that directly target podocyte injury, and the upstream regulation of HIF-1alpha-driven ferroptosis in podocytes remains unclear. This study investigated whether astragaloside IV (AS-IV) protects against DKD by regulating the PHD2/HIF-1alpha axis. A DKD mouse model was induced by a high-fat/high-sugar diet plus streptozotocin, followed by AS-IV intervention (100 mg/kg/day for 12 weeks). In vitro, podocytes were exposed to high glucose (30 mM) with AS-IV (40 mumol/L), along with the HIF-1alpha inhibitor LW6 or activator DMOG. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified HIF-1alpha signaling as a core pathway, with stable binding of AS-IV to PHD2 and HIF-1alpha. AS-IV improved renal function and pathology in DKD mice without affecting blood glucose. In vivo and in vitro, AS-IV activated PHD2, promoted HIF-1alpha ubiquitination and degradation, and subsequently inhibited podocyte ferroptosis, as shown by reduced iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation, and upregulated GPX4 and SLC7A11. Additionally, AS-IV suppressed pyroptosis and inflammation (reduced NLRP3, GSDMD-NT, IL-1beta, IL-18) and modulated apoptosis (increased Bcl2). In conclusion, the renoprotective effect of AS-IV is mediated through the PHD2/HIF-1alpha axis, reducing HIF-1alpha accumulation and thereby inhibiting podocyte ferroptosis, pyroptosis, inflammation, and fibrosis in DKD. These findings provide a novel mechanistic foundation for AS-IV as a prospective therapeutic agent for DKD.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）缺乏直接靶向足细胞损伤的治疗方法，且足细胞中HIF-1α驱动的铁死亡的上游调控机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨了黄芪甲苷IV（AS-IV）是否通过调节PHD2/HIF-1α轴来保护DKD。通过高脂/高糖饮食联合链脲佐菌素诱导DKD小鼠模型，随后给予AS-IV干预（100 mg/kg/天，持续12周）。体外实验中，足细胞暴露于高糖（30 mM）并加入AS-IV（40 μmol/L），同时使用HIF-1α抑制剂LW6或激活剂DMOG。网络药理学和分子对接鉴定HIF-1α信号为核心通路，且AS-IV与PHD2和HIF-1α具有稳定结合。AS-IV改善了DKD小鼠的肾功能和病理，且不影响血糖。体内和体外实验中，AS-IV激活PHD2，促进HIF-1α泛素化和降解，进而抑制足细胞铁死亡，表现为铁积累和脂质过氧化减少，GPX4和SLC7A11上调。此外，AS-IV抑制了焦亡和炎症（NLRP3、GSDMD-NT、IL-1β、IL-18降低），并调节凋亡（Bcl2升高）。总之，AS-IV的肾脏保护作用通过PHD2/HIF-1α轴介导，减少HIF-1α积累，从而抑制DKD中足细胞铁死亡、焦亡、炎症和纤维化。这些发现为AS-IV作为DKD潜在治疗药物提供了新的机制基础。
